key_claims: Narcolepsy is a chronic neurological condition.
Narcolepsy involves disruptions in the regulation of sleep-wake cycles.
People with narcolepsy often experience extreme daytime sleepiness.
In some cases, people with narcolepsy experience cataplexy, a sudden but temporary loss of muscle strength while conscious.
limitations: The source does not specify the number of people affected by narcolepsy.
The source does not detail the mechanisms linking laughter to cataplexy.
The source does not mention any treatments or management strategies.
what_not_to_say: The source does not state that laughter is the only trigger for cataplexy.
The source does not claim that all people with narcolepsy experience cataplexy.
The source does not provide statistics on the prevalence of narcolepsy or cataplexy.
